_comment: Constants and formulas that were previously hardcoded (differently, in several places) across ad hoc scripts. Consolidated here so the whole pipeline and any future game engine reads the same numbers.

setup.stacking_cap_scope: a starting-setup purchase limit only (not an in-game limit): every unit purchased at a territory counts against that territory's cap, including naval units and any air unit riding an Aircraft Carrier's escort, even though those deploy to a sea zone rather than the land territory itself
setup.naval_purchase_rule: naval units may only be purchased at a coastal territory (has >=1 adjacent sea zone) and deploy to that sea zone, not the land territory
setup.no_shared_sea_zones_rule: no two factions may deploy naval units (or carrier-based aircraft) to the same sea zone in the starting setup
setup.excluded_naval_zones_note: sea zone id 43 (Caspian Sea) never hosts a naval deployment, default or override, in any starting-setup scenario
setup.carrier_escort_rule: every purchased Aircraft Carrier must have at least 1 escorting Fighter or Bomber, which deploys to the carrier's own sea zone instead of a land territory
setup.mandatory_land_unit_rule: every land territory with a foreign-faction land neighbor must have at least 1 land unit (Infantry, Mechanized Infantry, or Armor) at setup -- does not need to be specifically Infantry
setup.unit_diversity_rule: each faction must purchase at least 6 of the 8 purchasable unit types in its starting setup; data/factions.json's per-faction 'focus' list guides which types are emphasized (by spend/quantity), not which types are excluded
setup.leftover_budget_rule: spend the full per-faction budget; when there is a small remainder that can't buy a whole new unit, upgrade an existing Infantry to Mechanized Infantry to use it up

combat.hit_rule: attack die roll >= target's defense is a hit; the max value on the die always hits
combat.damage_rule: a hit deals damage equal to the attacker's damage rating; max-die hits deal half damage rounded down
combat.casualty_resolution: attacker rolls all attacks first (defending casualties noted, not removed), then defender rolls all attacks (both sides' casualties removed together)
combat.recovery_rule: damage persists; a unit that has not been in combat since the start of its previous turn returns to full HP at the start of the turn
combat.contested_territory_rule: if units remain on both sides after 3 rounds, the territory stays with its original owner, contributes no IPC to either side, and only the owner's Infantry may be mustered there until resolved

promotion.effect: permanent combat bonus: attack die steps up one size (max D12), +1 defense (max 10), +1 HP
promotion.demotion: not specified in the current design doc revision

map.adjacency_source: Delaunay triangulation over territory center points, edges kept under a 420px length threshold
map.adjacency_fallback: territories added to the map after the adjacency graph was built (currently Iran id 145, Himalayan Bengal id 146) are not in the graph; their neighbors are approximated by the same 420px center-to-center distance threshold against all other land territories
map.foreign_neighbor_flag_definition: a land territory has at least one land neighbor belonging to a different faction
